specs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE new individual pixel-art keyframe for a digital pet game, to review in Figma before animation.
Input image 1 is the source character identity and pixel style reference. Input image 2 is the source pose vocabulary, NOT a request to recreate the entire sheet.
Generate only ONE character in ONE pose. Match the source character's exact anatomy, proportions, colors, features and charming compact silhouette. Crisp deliberate square pixel clusters, dark one-pixel-style outline, limited palette, flat game-sprite shading. Aim for the detail density of a 96x96 pixel sprite enlarged to a square 1024x1024 image with nearest-neighbor-looking hard edges. No smooth vector curves, painterly rendering, antialiasing, gradients, texture noise or 3D.
Transparent alpha background. Entire body and extremities in frame, centered horizontally, ample empty margin, consistent orthographic slightly three-quarter view toward the RIGHT. Neutral poses rest at 85% canvas height, character occupies roughly 55-65% of square height. No text, labels, multiple poses, panels, floor, ground shadow, glow, environment, props, particles, food or effects. This is a candidate keyframe, not a complete animation.
Botamon idle: compact soft black-charcoal round furry blob, two little rounded ear-like upper bumps, large simple bright yellow oval eyes. No limbs, no tail, no visible mouth in this neutral pose. Calm attentive grounded resting pose. Preserve short fuzzy contour and subtly warmer charcoal shading from the references; do not turn into a cat or invent paws.
